about: Decals (Improvement Ideas W10, docs/art/decals.md): sheets of four marks on white painted by Gemini (2K, art/prompts/decal_preamble.txt, a look target frame as the style reference) and cut apart by blender/make_decals.py into art/textures/decals/<sheet>_<n>.webp with soft alpha and a normal map. view: floor (seen from above) or wall (seen straight on, its bottom edge at the foot of the wall). along: marks that run on (ruts): cut to their straight middle with long soft ends, for laying end to end.
prompt: A 2 x 2 grid of four separate {what} marks, each centred alone in its own quarter of the picture with wide plain white all round it, none touching the edges or each other: top left, {a}; top right, {b}; bottom left, {c}; bottom right, {d}. {view} Draw only the four marks on white, not a scene, a floor or a place.

views.floor: Each is seen straight from above, as if lying on a floor (orthographic, no perspective).
views.wall: Each is seen straight on, as if on a wall, with its bottom at the bottom of its quarter (orthographic, no perspective).
